## Common Mistakes

- Allowing the torso to lean too far forward
- Keeping the torso too upright
- Not squatting with a rigid torso

## Descent

1. Push hips back
2. Simultaneously flex knees while pushing hips back
3. Maintain torso angle throughout lift
4. Distribute bodyweight from the balls of the feet to the heels
5. Keep knees behind the balls of the feet
6. Maintain slow, controlled descent
7. Keep shins as vertical as possible by sitting back into the squat
8. At the bottom, do not bounce, jerk, or stop the motion
9. Proper depth is achieved when mid-thigh is parallel to the floor (-47)

## Common Mistakes

- Shins not being vertical
- Rounding the back
- Dropping down too quickly into the squat (not slow and controlled)
